requirements_summary: Workload: internal support-agent + knowledge search across policy/runbooks; summarization of incident notes; some chat-based troubleshooting for NOC. Expected volume: initial 15–25 QPS bursty during incidents; target p95 latency < 1.5s for short-form responses, streaming required. Data handling: wants explicit statement 'no training on customer data' and clear retention controls for prompts/outputs and logs.
